hook: Your Rs 500 note changes colour when you tilt it.
title: Your Rs 500 note changes colour when tilted
description:
On the Rs 500 note, the numeral 500 shifts from green to blue when you tilt it. That is colour-shifting ink, a security feature that is hard to copy. Grab a note and try it.

#Shorts #Rupee #Facts
